project.name: Story Corner
project.warning: The PETG parts are finish and item-retention pieces only. They are not brackets, beams, wall anchors, or a certified load-rated assembly.

printer.filament: black PETG; brand and product line UNCONFIRMED

inside_corner.plan_handedness: viewed from the closet opening, the 5 ft through arm extends along the right wall and the 3 ft return occupies the back wall; FIELD VERIFY
inside_corner.coordinate_axes: positive long-wall and short-wall stations both run outward from the finished-wall intersection
inside_corner.coordinate_datum: intersection of the two finished wall planes at the inside corner
inside_corner.fit_strategy: 5 ft plywood deck runs through the corner; the 3 ft return deck butts into its front edge; PETG covers are cosmetic only

runs.label: 3 ft wall shelf
runs.deck_span_mode: return_begins_after_through_deck_front_plane; through deck supplies the corner surface

closet.support_rule: Nominal support centers show the desired geometry only. Every standard must land on verified wood framing or purpose-installed structural blocking; do not move a support into hollow wall space to match the drawing.
closet.common_shelf_top_elevation_status: UNCONFIRMED; establish one laser datum for both arms

structural.front_stiffener: 1 x 1 x 1/8 in continuous steel angle
structural.standard_basis: KV 82 Series double-slot steel wall standard or an equivalently documented complete system
structural.bracket_basis: KV 182 Series 7 in steel bracket for an 8 in shelf or an equivalently documented complete system
structural.serviceability_check_load_scope: total development line-load proxy chosen above the approximately 24.3 lb/ft contents-selection density to include a rough shelf-dead-load allowance; not a measured dead load, safety factor, or rating
structural.corner_alignment_hardware_note: Optional field-fitted slotted steel underside plates may assist coplanar alignment after the actual brackets are dry-fitted; do not rigidly force the angle ends together, replace independent bracket support, or use the plates as a load-rating basis.

finish_attachment.top_tile_method: one small centered dot of removable neutral-cure silicone per tile on sealed plywood; qualify on PETG and the actual finish, keep every perimeter and 0.6 mm seam free to move, and remove with floss rather than prying
finish_attachment.rear_curb_method: one field-drilled clearance slot per straight curb piece and one per arm of the corner replacement, using short nonstructural pan-head screws into plywood after a bottom-clearance check; do not clamp PETG rigidly
finish_attachment.fascia_method: the full-depth upper and lower channel flanges mechanically capture the fascia around the real shelf stack; assemble the lateral train before the two outer endcaps and re-entrant corner cover, then use one tiny centered removable neutral-cure silicone dot inside each channel only to prevent creep and rattle; do not drill or notch the continuous steel angle
finish_attachment.entablature_overlay_method: one tiny centered removable neutral-cure silicone dot to its own fascia half after the actual PETG surfaces pass the adhesion and floss-removal coupon; no overlay may bridge a 0.6 mm fascia seam
finish_attachment.keystone_method: two pinhead-size removable neutral-cure silicone dots on one arch half only; the opposite side floats across the 0.6 mm center seam
finish_attachment.groin_vault_method: two generated clearance slots and short nonstructural pan-head screws into the underside of the through-owned plywood only after a depth stop and bracket-clearance check; never bridge the plywood joint
finish_attachment.corner_pilaster_method: two tiny removable neutral-cure silicone dots inside one upper leg only; the perpendicular leg floats and no adhesive crosses the corner seam
finish_attachment.endcap_method: two tiny removable neutral-cure silicone dots inside the final fascia channel plus a hand pull-check before loading; inspect after every move
finish_attachment.qualification: Every proposed adhesive and fastener must be tested on printed PETG, sealed plywood, and the actual coated steel. Attachment prevents creep, rattle, and falling only; it receives no shelf-load or cargo-restraint credit.

palatine.design_language: Triadic Palatine Order: Egyptian battered/cavetto geometry, Greek fluting and triglyph rhythm, Roman semicircular arcades and coffers, governed by a 3-6-9 pattern
palatine.entablature_overlay_alignment: top_aligned_to_fascia; never bridge a segment seam
palatine.printer_assumption_note: The 1.2 mm minimum relief is a geometry-development choice only. Confirm the printer and nozzle and print the Palatine detail coupon before production.
